---
title: "How a tree chooses a split"
toc: false
page-layout: full
---

A binary classification tree builds a rule one decision at a time. At each
node, it tries candidate cutpoints along every available feature, measures how
much each candidate makes the two child regions purer, and selects the
largest improvement.

::: {.callout-tip}
## Follow the search

This page makes the search explicit. Run the $x_1$ loop and the $x_2$
loop for the root node, select the winning split, and then repeat that process
for each of its two children. The table records the Gini decrease for every
candidate cutpoint that the tree evaluates.
:::

For a region $R$, the Gini impurity and the decrease from a candidate split
are

$$
G(R) = 1 - \sum_{k=1}^{K} \hat{p}_{R,k}^{\,2},
\qquad
\Delta G
= G(R) -
\left[
\frac{n_L}{n}G(R_L) + \frac{n_R}{n}G(R_R)
\right].
$$

Here, a larger $\Delta G$ is better.

The data are deliberately small and hand-designed so the full search fits on
one page. Real implementations use the same logic, but sort observations once
per feature and evaluate only legal boundaries between distinct values.

[Return to Tree-based models](index.qmd)

<script>
(() => {
  const samples = [
    { id: 1, x1: 0.45, x2: 3.30, label: 0 },
    { id: 2, x1: 0.80, x2: 2.75, label: 0 },
    { id: 3, x1: 1.30, x2: 3.50, label: 1 },
    { id: 4, x1: 2.10, x2: 2.70, label: 1 },
    { id: 5, x1: 2.40, x2: 3.15, label: 1 },
    { id: 6, x1: 2.80, x2: 3.45, label: 1 },
    { id: 7, x1: 3.10, x2: 2.85, label: 1 },
    { id: 8, x1: 3.60, x2: 3.30, label: 0 },
    { id: 9, x1: 0.50, x2: 0.60, label: 0 },
    { id: 10, x1: 0.85, x2: 1.40, label: 0 },
    { id: 11, x1: 1.15, x2: 2.10, label: 0 },
    { id: 12, x1: 1.45, x2: 0.90, label: 0 },
    { id: 13, x1: 1.70, x2: 1.80, label: 0 },
    { id: 14, x1: 2.10, x2: 0.55, label: 0 },
    { id: 15, x1: 2.60, x2: 1.30, label: 1 },
    { id: 16, x1: 3.00, x2: 1.90, label: 1 }
  ];

  const features = ["x1", "x2"];
  const featureLabels = { x1: "x₁", x2: "x₂" };
  const svg = document.getElementById("tree-gini-svg");
  const nextButton = document.getElementById("tree-gini-next");
  const runButton = document.getElementById("tree-gini-run");
  const resetButton = document.getElementById("tree-gini-reset");
  const status = document.getElementById("tree-gini-status");
  const nodeSummary = document.getElementById("tree-gini-node-summary");
  const featureWinner = document.getElementById("tree-gini-feature-winner");
  const winner = document.getElementById("tree-gini-winner");
  const dataTable = document.getElementById("tree-gini-data-table");
  const tableTitle = document.getElementById("tree-gini-table-title");
  const tableBody = document.getElementById("tree-gini-table-body");
  const rulesList = document.getElementById("tree-gini-rules-list");

  const chart = {
    left: 76,
    right: 618,
    top: 32,
    bottom: 404,
    xMin: 0.2,
    xMax: 3.9,
    yMin: 0.2,
    yMax: 3.9
  };

  const rootBounds = {
    xMin: chart.xMin,
    xMax: chart.xMax,
    yMin: chart.yMin,
    yMax: chart.yMax
  };

  let state;

  function round(value, digits) {
    return Number(value.toFixed(digits || 3));
  }

  function xPixel(value) {
    return chart.left + ((value - chart.xMin) / (chart.xMax - chart.xMin)) * (chart.right - chart.left);
  }

  function yPixel(value) {
    return chart.bottom - ((value - chart.yMin) / (chart.yMax - chart.yMin)) * (chart.bottom - chart.top);
  }

  function countLabels(observations) {
    const positive = observations.filter((sample) => sample.label === 1).length;
    return { positive: positive, negative: observations.length - positive };
  }

  function gini(observations) {
    if (observations.length === 0) {
      return 0;
    }
    const counts = countLabels(observations);
    const positiveShare = counts.positive / observations.length;
    const negativeShare = counts.negative / observations.length;
    return 1 - positiveShare * positiveShare - negativeShare * negativeShare;
  }

  function thresholds(observations, feature) {
    const values = Array.from(new Set(observations.map((sample) => sample[feature]))).sort((a, b) => a - b);
    return values.slice(0, -1).map((value, index) => (value + values[index + 1]) / 2);
  }

  function evaluate(node, feature, threshold) {
    const left = node.samples.filter((sample) => sample[feature] <= threshold);
    const right = node.samples.filter((sample) => sample[feature] > threshold);
    const parentGini = gini(node.samples);
    const weightedChildGini =
      (left.length / node.samples.length) * gini(left) +
      (right.length / node.samples.length) * gini(right);

    return {
      node: node,
      feature: feature,
      threshold: threshold,
      left: left,
      right: right,
      parentGini: parentGini,
      weightedChildGini: weightedChildGini,
      decrease: parentGini - weightedChildGini
    };
  }

  function candidates(node, feature) {
    return thresholds(node.samples, feature).map((threshold) => evaluate(node, feature, threshold));
  }

  function bestCandidate(node, feature) {
    return candidates(node, feature).reduce((best, candidate) => {
      return candidate.decrease > best.decrease ? candidate : best;
    });
  }

  function makeChildren(node, split) {
    const leftBounds = {
      xMin: node.bounds.xMin,
      xMax: node.bounds.xMax,
      yMin: node.bounds.yMin,
      yMax: node.bounds.yMax
    };
    const rightBounds = {
      xMin: node.bounds.xMin,
      xMax: node.bounds.xMax,
      yMin: node.bounds.yMin,
      yMax: node.bounds.yMax
    };

    if (split.feature === "x1") {
      leftBounds.xMax = split.threshold;
      rightBounds.xMin = split.threshold;
    } else {
      leftBounds.yMax = split.threshold;
      rightBounds.yMin = split.threshold;
    }

    return [
      {
        id: node.id + "-left",
        title: node.id === "root" ? "root: ≤ child" : node.title + ": ≤ child",
        samples: split.left,
        bounds: leftBounds,
        depth: node.depth + 1
      },
      {
        id: node.id + "-right",
        title: node.id === "root" ? "root: > child" : node.title + ": > child",
        samples: split.right,
        bounds: rightBounds,
        depth: node.depth + 1
      }
    ];
  }

  function reset() {
    const root = {
      id: "root",
      title: "root node",
      samples: samples,
      bounds: rootBounds,
      depth: 0
    };
    state = {
      queue: [root],
      nodeIndex: 0,
      featureIndex: 0,
      evaluated: 0,
      leaves: [root],
      rules: [],
      completed: false
    };
    update();
  }

  function currentNode() {
    return state.queue[state.nodeIndex];
  }

  function currentCandidates() {
    return candidates(currentNode(), features[state.featureIndex]);
  }

  function loopFinished() {
    return state.evaluated >= currentCandidates().length;
  }

  function bothFeatureLoopsFinished() {
    return state.featureIndex === 1 && loopFinished();
  }

  function nodeName(node) {
    return node.id === "root" ? "the root node" : "the " + node.title;
  }

  function groupText(observations) {
    const counts = countLabels(observations);
    return counts.positive + " / " + counts.negative;
  }

  function selectedRuleText(rule) {
    return featureLabels[rule.split.feature] + " ≤ " + rule.split.threshold.toFixed(2);
  }

  function selectBestSplit() {
    const node = currentNode();
    const first = bestCandidate(node, "x1");
    const second = bestCandidate(node, "x2");
    const split = second.decrease > first.decrease ? second : first;
    const children = makeChildren(node, split);

    state.rules.push({ node: node, split: split });
    state.leaves = state.leaves.filter((leaf) => leaf.id !== node.id).concat(children);

    if (node.id === "root") {
      state.queue.push(children[0], children[1]);
    }

    state.nodeIndex += 1;
    state.featureIndex = 0;
    state.evaluated = 0;
    if (state.nodeIndex >= state.queue.length) {
      state.completed = true;
    }
    update();
  }

  function advance() {
    if (state.completed) {
      return;
    }

    if (!loopFinished()) {
      state.evaluated += 1;
      update();
      return;
    }

    if (state.featureIndex === 0) {
      state.featureIndex = 1;
      state.evaluated = 0;
      update();
      return;
    }

    selectBestSplit();
  }

  function runLoop() {
    if (state.completed) {
      return;
    }
    if (!loopFinished()) {
      state.evaluated = currentCandidates().length;
      update();
    }
  }

  function updateControls() {
    if (state.completed) {
      nextButton.textContent = "All three split decisions complete";
      nextButton.disabled = true;
      runButton.disabled = true;
      return;
    }

    if (!loopFinished()) {
      nextButton.textContent = "Evaluate next candidate";
      runButton.textContent = "Run this feature loop";
      nextButton.disabled = false;
      runButton.disabled = false;
      return;
    }

    if (state.featureIndex === 0) {
      nextButton.textContent = "Move to x₂ candidates";
      runButton.textContent = "Feature loop complete";
      nextButton.disabled = false;
      runButton.disabled = true;
      return;
    }

    nextButton.textContent = "Choose the best split";
    runButton.textContent = "Feature loop complete";
    nextButton.disabled = false;
    runButton.disabled = true;
  }

  function updateStatus() {
    if (state.completed) {
      status.textContent = "Three split decisions are complete: the root and each of its two children were searched independently.";
      return;
    }

    const node = currentNode();
    const feature = featureLabels[features[state.featureIndex]];
    const total = currentCandidates().length;
    if (!loopFinished()) {
      status.textContent =
        "For loop: evaluate " + feature + " candidates in " + nodeName(node) +
        " (" + state.evaluated + " of " + total + " completed).";
      return;
    }
    if (state.featureIndex === 0) {
      status.textContent =
        "The " + feature + " loop is complete for " + nodeName(node) +
        ". Now repeat the same search for x₂.";
      return;
    }
    status.textContent =
      "Both feature loops are complete for " + nodeName(node) +
      ". Compare their best Gini decreases and choose one split.";
  }

  function makeCell(row, content) {
    const cell = document.createElement("td");
    cell.textContent = content;
    row.appendChild(cell);
  }

  function updateTable() {
    if (state.completed) {
      tableTitle.textContent = "Final selected split rules";
      tableBody.replaceChildren();
      return;
    }

    const node = currentNode();
    const feature = features[state.featureIndex];
    const rows = candidates(node, feature);
    tableTitle.textContent =
      "Candidate cutpoints: " + featureLabels[feature] + " in " + node.title;
    tableBody.replaceChildren();

    rows.forEach((candidate, index) => {
      const row = document.createElement("tr");
      const isEvaluated = index < state.evaluated;
      const isCurrent = index === state.evaluated && !loopFinished();
      if (isEvaluated) {
        row.classList.add("tree-gini-evaluated");
      }
      if (isCurrent) {
        row.classList.add("tree-gini-current");
      }

      makeCell(row, featureLabels[feature]);
      makeCell(row, candidate.threshold.toFixed(2));
      if (isEvaluated) {
        makeCell(row, groupText(candidate.left));
        makeCell(row, groupText(candidate.right));
        makeCell(row, candidate.weightedChildGini.toFixed(3));
        makeCell(row, candidate.decrease.toFixed(3));
      } else {
        makeCell(row, "—");
        makeCell(row, "—");
        makeCell(row, "—");
        makeCell(row, "—");
      }
      tableBody.appendChild(row);
    });
  }

  function updateSummary() {
    if (state.completed) {
      nodeSummary.textContent = "All three nodes have been searched.";
      featureWinner.textContent = "Each winning rule is listed below.";
      winner.textContent = "The colored regions on the left show the resulting three splits.";
      dataTable.replaceChildren();
      return;
    }

    const node = currentNode();
    const counts = countLabels(node.samples);
    nodeSummary.textContent =
      node.title + ": " + node.samples.length + " observations (" +
      counts.positive + " positive, " + counts.negative + " negative); " +
      "parent Gini = " + gini(node.samples).toFixed(3) + ".";

    const feature = features[state.featureIndex];
    if (state.evaluated > 0) {
      const bestSoFar = currentCandidates()
        .slice(0, state.evaluated)
        .reduce((best, candidate) => candidate.decrease > best.decrease ? candidate : best);
      featureWinner.textContent =
        "Best evaluated " + featureLabels[feature] + " candidate so far: " +
        selectedRuleText({ split: bestSoFar }) +
        ", with Gini decrease " + bestSoFar.decrease.toFixed(3) + ".";
    } else {
      featureWinner.textContent =
        "No " + featureLabels[feature] + " cutpoint has been evaluated yet.";
    }

    if (bothFeatureLoopsFinished()) {
      const bestX1 = bestCandidate(node, "x1");
      const bestX2 = bestCandidate(node, "x2");
      const best = bestX2.decrease > bestX1.decrease ? bestX2 : bestX1;
      winner.textContent =
        "Winner across both features: " + selectedRuleText({ split: best }) +
        ", with Gini decrease " + best.decrease.toFixed(3) + ".";
    } else {
      winner.textContent =
        "Complete both feature loops before selecting a split for this node.";
    }

    const table = document.createElement("table");
    const head = document.createElement("thead");
    const headRow = document.createElement("tr");
    ["ID", "x₁", "x₂", "Label"].forEach((label) => {
      const cell = document.createElement("th");
      cell.scope = "col";
      cell.textContent = label;
      headRow.appendChild(cell);
    });
    head.appendChild(headRow);
    const body = document.createElement("tbody");
    node.samples.forEach((sample) => {
      const row = document.createElement("tr");
      [sample.id, sample.x1.toFixed(2), sample.x2.toFixed(2), sample.label].forEach((value) => {
        makeCell(row, String(value));
      });
      body.appendChild(row);
    });
    table.appendChild(head);
    table.appendChild(body);
    dataTable.replaceChildren(table);
  }

  function leafColor(leaf) {
    const counts = countLabels(leaf.samples);
    return counts.positive >= counts.negative ? "#fff1ed" : "#ecfdf5";
  }

  function svgElement(name, attributes) {
    const element = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", name);
    Object.entries(attributes).forEach(([key, value]) => element.setAttribute(key, value));
    return element;
  }

  function drawPlot() {
    svg.replaceChildren();

    state.leaves.forEach((leaf) => {
      const rect = svgElement("rect", {
        x: xPixel(leaf.bounds.xMin),
        y: yPixel(leaf.bounds.yMax),
        width: xPixel(leaf.bounds.xMax) - xPixel(leaf.bounds.xMin),
        height: yPixel(leaf.bounds.yMin) - yPixel(leaf.bounds.yMax),
        fill: leafColor(leaf),
        opacity: "0.82"
      });
      svg.appendChild(rect);
    });

    [1, 2, 3].forEach((tick) => {
      const vertical = svgElement("line", {
        x1: xPixel(tick), y1: chart.top, x2: xPixel(tick), y2: chart.bottom,
        stroke: "#cbd5e1", "stroke-dasharray": "5 6", "stroke-width": "1"
      });
      const horizontal = svgElement("line", {
        x1: chart.left, y1: yPixel(tick), x2: chart.right, y2: yPixel(tick),
        stroke: "#cbd5e1", "stroke-dasharray": "5 6", "stroke-width": "1"
      });
      svg.appendChild(vertical);
      svg.appendChild(horizontal);

      const xLabel = svgElement("text", {
        x: xPixel(tick), y: chart.bottom + 30, "text-anchor": "middle",
        fill: "#334155", "font-size": "18"
      });
      xLabel.textContent = tick;
      svg.appendChild(xLabel);
      const yLabel = svgElement("text", {
        x: chart.left - 22, y: yPixel(tick) + 6, "text-anchor": "end",
        fill: "#334155", "font-size": "18"
      });
      yLabel.textContent = tick;
      svg.appendChild(yLabel);
    });

    svg.appendChild(svgElement("line", {
      x1: chart.left, y1: chart.bottom, x2: chart.right + 18, y2: chart.bottom,
      stroke: "#334155", "stroke-width": "2"
    }));
    svg.appendChild(svgElement("line", {
      x1: chart.left, y1: chart.bottom, x2: chart.left, y2: chart.top - 12,
      stroke: "#334155", "stroke-width": "2"
    }));
    const xAxis = svgElement("text", {
      x: chart.right + 30, y: chart.bottom + 8, fill: "#0f172a",
      "font-size": "24", "font-style": "italic"
    });
    xAxis.textContent = "x₁";
    svg.appendChild(xAxis);
    const yAxis = svgElement("text", {
      x: chart.left - 10, y: chart.top - 16, fill: "#0f172a",
      "font-size": "24", "font-style": "italic"
    });
    yAxis.textContent = "x₂";
    svg.appendChild(yAxis);

    state.rules.forEach((rule) => {
      const split = rule.split;
      const isRoot = rule.node.id === "root";
      const color = isRoot ? "#2563eb" : "#dc2626";
      if (split.feature === "x1") {
        svg.appendChild(svgElement("line", {
          x1: xPixel(split.threshold), y1: yPixel(rule.node.bounds.yMin),
          x2: xPixel(split.threshold), y2: yPixel(rule.node.bounds.yMax),
          stroke: color, "stroke-width": "4", "stroke-dasharray": "10 8"
        }));
      } else {
        svg.appendChild(svgElement("line", {
          x1: xPixel(rule.node.bounds.xMin), y1: yPixel(split.threshold),
          x2: xPixel(rule.node.bounds.xMax), y2: yPixel(split.threshold),
          stroke: color, "stroke-width": "4", "stroke-dasharray": "10 8"
        }));
      }
    });

    samples.forEach((sample) => {
      const x = xPixel(sample.x1);
      const y = yPixel(sample.x2);
      if (sample.label === 1) {
        const size = 10;
        const triangle = svgElement("path", {
          d: "M " + x + " " + (y - size) + " L " + (x - size) + " " + (y + size) +
             " L " + (x + size) + " " + (y + size) + " Z",
          fill: "#ef4444", stroke: "#b91c1c", "stroke-width": "1.2"
        });
        svg.appendChild(triangle);
      } else {
        svg.appendChild(svgElement("circle", {
          cx: x, cy: y, r: "10", fill: "#34d399", stroke: "#047857", "stroke-width": "1.2"
        }));
      }
    });

    const legend = svgElement("g", {});
    legend.appendChild(svgElement("path", {
      d: "M 103 438 L 94 454 L 112 454 Z", fill: "#ef4444", stroke: "#b91c1c", "stroke-width": "1"
    }));
    const positive = svgElement("text", { x: "120", y: "452", fill: "#334155", "font-size": "15" });
    positive.textContent = "positive label";
    legend.appendChild(positive);
    legend.appendChild(svgElement("circle", {
      cx: "260", cy: "446", r: "8", fill: "#34d399", stroke: "#047857", "stroke-width": "1"
    }));
    const negative = svgElement("text", { x: "274", y: "452", fill: "#334155", "font-size": "15" });
    negative.textContent = "negative label";
    legend.appendChild(negative);
    svg.appendChild(legend);
  }

  function updateRules() {
    rulesList.replaceChildren();
    if (state.rules.length === 0) {
      const item = document.createElement("li");
      item.textContent = "No split has been selected yet.";
      rulesList.appendChild(item);
      return;
    }

    state.rules.forEach((rule) => {
      const item = document.createElement("li");
      item.textContent =
        rule.node.title + ": " + selectedRuleText(rule) +
        " (Gini decrease = " + rule.split.decrease.toFixed(3) + ").";
      rulesList.appendChild(item);
    });
  }

  function update() {
    updateControls();
    updateStatus();
    updateTable();
    updateSummary();
    drawPlot();
    updateRules();
  }

  nextButton.addEventListener("click", advance);
  runButton.addEventListener("click", runLoop);
  resetButton.addEventListener("click", reset);
  reset();
})();
</script>
